title: Veterans' Compensation COLA Act of 2016
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the House passed version is repeated here.)

Veterans' Compensation COLA Act of 2016

(Sec. 2) This bill directs the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to increase, as of December 1, 2016, the rates of veterans' disability compensation, additional compensation for dependents, the clothing allowance for certain disabled veterans, and dependency and indemnity compensation for surviving spouses and children.

Each such increase shall be the same percentage as the increase in benefits provided under title II (Old Age, Survivors, and Disability Insurance [OASDI]) of the Social Security Act, on the same effective date.

(Sec. 3) The VA shall publish such increased amounts in the Federal Register not later than the date on which certain OASDI cost-of-living increases are required to be published during FY2017.

summary.headline: This law requires the VA to raise several veterans' and survivors' benefit payments by the same percentage as Social Security benefits starting December 1, 2016.
summary.what_it_does: It directs the Department of Veterans Affairs to increase disability compensation, extra payments for dependents, the clothing allowance for certain disabled veterans, and dependency and indemnity compensation for surviving spouses and children. The increase uses the same percentage as the cost-of-living increase for Social Security (OASDI) benefits, effective on the same date. The VA must also publish the new amounts in the Federal Register by the deadline set for Social Security increases in fiscal year 2017.

who_it_affects.how: Their monthly disability payments increase by the same percentage as Social Security benefits beginning December 1, 2016.
The extra amounts paid for spouses, children, and other dependents also increase by the same percentage.

who_it_affects.group: Certain disabled veterans who receive the clothing allowance
who_it_affects.how: Their clothing allowance amount increases by the same percentage.

who_it_affects.group: Surviving spouses and children receiving dependency and indemnity compensation
who_it_affects.how: Their survivor payments increase by the same percentage as Social Security benefits.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The increases take effect December 1, 2016, and the VA must publish the new amounts in the Federal Register by the FY2017 deadline for Social Security increases.
